stories.title: Two-stage thumbnail->highRes load in EditablePhotoView
acceptanceCriteria: EditablePhotoView.swift replaces the single `@State private var image: NSImage?` with `thumbnail`/`highRes`/`isLoadingHighRes` state matching PhotoViewerView.swift's pattern
`.task(id: photo?.id)` loads `ImageLoader.shared.thumbnail(for:)` first, checks `Task.isCancelled`, then loads `ImageLoader.shared.highResImage(for:)`
Rotation (`editInfo?.rotation`) and crop overlay (`isCropMode`, `CropOverlayView`) logic is preserved unchanged in behavior
Project builds successfully via `xcodebuild -project ShootLog.xcodeproj -scheme ShootLog build` (or equivalent) with zero errors
